hook.title: My satellite sim is accurate to *1 meter*. Here's how I know.

scenes.title: If it misses, the build *fails*
scenes.caption: the verification gate in CI goes red

caption:
Most orbit visualizers look right. I wanted mine to be right.

Every propagation in Burnline gets cross-checked against Vallado's own code (the textbook most of the industry learned from). If a satellite drifts more than 1 meter in position or 1 mm/s in velocity, the verification gate in CI fails. It doesn't count until it passes.

C++17 engine, physics straight from Bate/Mueller/White and Vallado. No Cesium, my own Earth model.

What should I add next?
